sessions.title: Repository foundation (turn 1) and operations desk foundation with its first vertical slice (turn 2)
sessions.agent: Claude Code (cloud session) for Paul Phillips
sessions.summary: Unpacked and audited the launch packet; installed and verified the toolchain; built dev log, delivery tracking, validators, CI and the Pages project hub; researched current vendor facts; wrote the foundation planning brief for the next turn's plan mode. Turn 2 (v0.2.0): built the operations desk foundation (SC-005) and its first vertical slice (SC-006 pitch intake with source and rights records, SC-007 editorial queue with Ghost references, first part of SC-009 agent gateway) on local Supabase, with database policy, unit, end-to-end, accessibility and bundle-secret tests.
